player_prompt.intro:
I Indian Poker khelhna ah Player {player_id} i ni.
- 52-card deck; i khingpui card chiah i hmu thei.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) theuh round tin, {max_rounds} round zawng zawng.
- Tih theihna: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X chu i chip neih zawng zawng aia tlem a ni tur a ni.)
- Card i thup/hmu loh sang ber in pot a la dawn nia showdown ah.

round.announce:
### Round {current_round}/{max_rounds}
I duh loh card hi: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Hming chiang tak bracketed action pe rawh, entirna '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', emaw '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: I hmachhawn thei lo [check] - in inhnek a ni.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet / Raise sum chu ≥ 1 a ni tûr.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: [bet] theih a ni lo - [call] / [raise] / [fold] a ngai a.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Inbiak tûr a awm lo; in [check] thei ang.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: [bet X] hmangin hawn rawh; bet tihpun tur a awm lo.
invalid_move.insufficient: Chu mi tih theih nân chip a tlêm hle.

message.round_result: {reason}  Pot {pot} → Player {winner} ah a lut. (Bankroll P0:{p0}, P1:{p1})
message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: pahnih {card}. Pot split  each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Round zawng zawngah chip inang vek a awm.
